name: Archaeology
short_description: The study of human history and prehistory through the excavation of sites and the analysis of artifacts.
jamb_subjects: English, History/Government, and any other two Arts or Social Science subjects
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes to include English Language, History/Government and three other Arts or Social Science subjects
deep_dive: Students explore archaeological field methods, cultural heritage management, and material analysis of past civilizations. The curriculum combines extensive fieldwork, laboratory dating techniques, and archival research. Graduates pursue careers as museum curators, heritage managers, cultural preservationists, and academic researchers.

name: Arabic Studies
short_description: Comprehensive study of Arabic language, literature, grammar, and Islamic cultural history.
jamb_subjects: English, Arabic, and two other Arts subjects
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes including English Language, Arabic and three other Arts subjects
deep_dive: The programme delves deeply into classical and modern standard Arabic syntax, morphology, literary criticism, and comparative Middle Eastern cultures. Undergraduates gain high linguistic fluency alongside analytical competencies in historical manuscripts. Career opportunities span translation, international diplomacy, foreign intelligence, publishing, and education.

name: Christian Religious Studies

jamb_subjects: English, Christian Religious Studies, and two other Arts or Social Science subjects
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes in English Language, CRK/CRS and three other Arts or Social Science subjects
deep_dive: Students investigate biblical exegesis, Old and New Testament hermeneutics, ethics, and contemporary religious dialogue. The academic focus develops critical thinking, pastoral counselling knowledge, and moral evaluation. Graduates work as educators, policy advisers, community development liaisons, and theological consultants.

name: Classical Studies

jamb_subjects: English, Literature in English, and any two Arts or Social Science subjects
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes including English Language, Literature in English and three other Arts or Social Science subjects
deep_dive: The degree explores Greco-Roman literary traditions, classical mythology, rhetoric, and philosophical foundations of modern political thought. Learners cultivate rigorous textual analysis and persuasive discourse. Career paths include diplomatic foreign service, journalism, legal consultancy, publishing, and cultural research.

name: Theatre Arts / Performing Arts

deep_dive: Courses encompass playwriting, stage design, film production, dramaturgy, and dance choreography. Practical studio productions and festival showcases prepare students for the creative entertainment industry. Career prospects include film directing, scriptwriting, media presentation, theatre management, and broadcast arts.

name: English Language and Literature
short_description: Rigorous study of
jamb_subjects: English linguistics, phonetics, semantics, and global literary traditions. English, Literature in English, and two other Arts or Social Science subjects
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes including English Language, Literature in English and three other Arts subjects
deep_dive: Students analyze grammatical theory, phonology, discourse analysis, African literature, and post-colonial studies. The curriculum hones sophisticated writing, editing, and critical rhetoric skills. Graduates thrive as corporate communications managers, editors, media broadcast journalists, and educators.

deep_dive: The programme balances world historical developments, Nigerian history, international treaties, and geopolitical strategy. Students develop strategic problem-solving and diplomatic negotiation skills. Alumni enter diplomatic services, intelligence agencies, international NGOs, policy think tanks, and public relations.

deep_dive: Focus areas encompass Hadith methodologies, Islamic commercial law, family jurisprudence, and Islamic history. The degree equips graduates with profound cultural competence and ethical advisory skills. Professional opportunities include legal advisory roles, academic research, diplomatic liaison, and community leadership.

The course instills exceptional problem formulation and argumentation abilities. Graduates frequently transition into law, policy analysis, strategic consulting, civil service, and publishing.

short_description: Functional mechanisms of organ systems, neurophysiology, endocrine pathways, and human cardiovascular control.
jamb_subjects: English, Biology, Chemistry, and Physics
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and Biology
deep_dive: Instruction covers cellular electrophysiology, endocrinology, renal excretion mechanisms, exercise stress testing, and physiological signal measurement. Intensive laboratory experiments using physiological transducers give students quantitative biological measurement skills. Alumni work as physiological researchers, cardiac technicians, sports science consultants, and clinical trial coordinators.

name: Public Health
faculty: Faculty of Medical and Health Sciences
short_description: Epidemiology, biostatistics, environmental health, disease outbreak prevention, and health policy planning.
jamb_subjects: English, Biology, Chemistry, and Physics or Mathematics
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes including English Language, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and Biology
deep_dive: The programme covers community epidemiology, infectious disease surveillance, health program monitoring, water sanitation, and global health economics. Field public health community surveys and NGO health project attachments furnish real-world interventions experience. Graduates become epidemiologists, public health officers, health program evaluators, and disease control officers.

name: Human Nutrition and Dietetics
faculty: Faculty of Medical and Health Sciences
short_description: Clinical nutritional therapy, community dietetics, food metabolism, therapeutic diets, and maternal nutrition.
jamb_subjects: English, Chemistry, Biology, and Physics or Mathematics
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics, Chemistry, Biology and Physics
deep_dive: Students learn dietary assessment methodologies, therapeutic meal formulation, clinical malnutrition intervention, and public health nutrition. Clinical hospital dietetic internships and community nutrition programs train students in clinical nutritional care. Career paths include registered clinical dietitians, public nutrition planners, wellness consultants, and pediatric nutritionists.

name: Optometry (OD)
faculty: Faculty of Medical and Health Sciences
short_description: Vision care, ocular disease diagnosis, refractive corrections, contact lenses, and low vision rehabilitation.
jamb_subjects: English, Biology, Chemistry, and Physics
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes including English Language, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and Biology
deep_dive: The curriculum integrates ocular anatomy, visual optics, ocular pharmacology, contact lens fitting, and surgical co-management of eye pathologies. Extensive clinical eye clinic externships develop diagnostic and refractive prescription skills. Graduates practice as licensed Doctors of Optometry (OD), primary eye care specialists, contact lens experts, and vision researchers.

name: Veterinary Medicine (DVM)
short_description: Animal surgery, veterinary pharmacology, livestock disease control, zoonoses prevention, and animal health pathology.
jamb_subjects: English, Biology, Chemistry, and Physics
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and Biology
deep_dive: Core subjects cover veterinary pathology, clinical companion/large animal surgery, herd epidemiology, and livestock disease biosecurity. Clinical rotations in veterinary teaching hospitals and ambulatory livestock clinics provide comprehensive diagnostic experience. Graduates qualify as registered veterinary doctors (DVM), livestock herd health managers, and animal quarantine directors.

name: Civil Law / Common Law
short_description: Constitutional jurisprudence, law of contract, criminal law, torts, international human rights law, and civil litigation.
jamb_subjects: English, Literature in English, and two other Arts or Social Science subjects
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes including English Language, Literature in English, Mathematics and two other subjects
deep_dive: Students study administrative law, commercial law, corporate legal practices, intellectual property, and international human rights jurisprudence. Moot court trials, legal aid clinics, and law firm internships develop persuasive advocacy and drafting skills. Graduates proceed to the Nigerian Law School to qualify as barristers and solicitors, corporate counsels, and judges.
offered_at_raw: UI, UNILAG, OAU, ABU, UNN, UNILORIN

name: Islamic Law / Common and Islamic Law
short_description: Islamic jurisprudence (Sharia), Islamic family law, criminal and civil codes, and comparative legal systems.
jamb_subjects: English, Islamic Studies/Arabic, and two other Arts or Social Science subjects
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes to include English Language, Islamic Studies/Arabic and three other subjects
deep_dive: Instruction covers Usul al-Fiqh, Islamic law of succession, commercial Islamic contracts, Nigerian statutory law, and comparative constitutional systems. Undergraduates participate in moot trials and judicial court observations in both Common Law and Sharia courts. Alumni practice as Sharia and common law legal practitioners, Islamic finance legal consultants, judges, and state counsels.

name: Economics
short_description: Microeconomic and macroeconomic theory, econometrics, public finance, monetary policy, and developmental economics.
jamb_subjects: English, Mathematics, Economics, and one other Social Science or Commercial subject
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes including English Language, Mathematics, Economics and two other subjects
deep_dive: The course explores quantitative economic modelling, fiscal policy analysis, econometric forecasting, international trade, and development strategies. Students solve empirical data modeling problems using statistical software packages. Graduates excel as economic policy analysts, investment bankers, econometricians, corporate planners, and research fellows.

name: Political Science
short_description: Political philosophy, public policy analysis, comparative government, political economy, and international relations.
jamb_subjects: English, Government/History, and two other Arts or Social Science subjects
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics, Government/History and two other subjects
deep_dive: The curriculum covers public policy evaluation, electoral systems, African political thought, international political economy, and political sociology. Practical legislative internships and policy research papers sharpen analytical thought. Graduates enter careers as public policy analysts, legislative aides, political strategists, diplomats, and civil service executives.

name: Sociology
short_description: Sociological theory, social stratification, community structures, urban sociology, and quantitative research methodology.
jamb_subjects: English, Government/History, and two other Arts or Social Science subjects
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes including English Language, Mathematics and three other Arts or Social Science subjects
deep_dive: Students study sociological theories, social problems, social research techniques, industrial sociology, and family structures. Undergraduates design field survey studies and complete social intervention internships. Alumni become social researchers, community development directors, human relations officers, and sociological policy analysts.

name: Psychology
short_description: Cognitive psychology, biopsychology, clinical psychopathology, developmental psychology, and psychological assessment.
jamb_subjects: English, and three other subjects from Science, Social Science, or Arts
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics, Biology and two other subjects
deep_dive: The degree features psychological testing, mental health therapy, organizational behavior, experimental human psychology, and forensic analysis. Students perform supervised psychometric lab tests and clinical psychiatric hospital internships. Graduates work as clinical psychologists, human resources specialists, behavioral analysts, rehabilitation counselors, and UX researchers.

name: Geography and Environmental Management
short_description: Spatial analysis, geomorphology, climate change assessment, environmental conservation, and remote sensing.
jamb_subjects: English, Geography, and two other Arts, Social Science or Science subjects
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes including English Language, Mathematics, Geography and two other subjects
deep_dive: The curriculum covers cartographic GIS analysis, climate adaptation planning, resource management, environmental impact assessments, and hydrological hazards. Field environmental measurement expeditions and GIS labs equip students with practical spatial tools. Graduates become GIS spatial analysts, environmental management officers, climatology consultants, and resource planners.

name: Demography and Social Statistics
short_description: Population dynamics, census data analytics, actuarial demography, mortality-fertility modeling, and vital statistics.
jamb_subjects: English, Mathematics, Economics, and one other Social Science subject
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics, Economics and two other subjects
deep_dive: Instruction focuses on census methodologies, life table construction, demographic projection modeling, reproductive health analytics, and migration studies. Population commission attachments and statistical surveys provide rich practical experience. Alumni advance as demographic data analysts, census officers, reproductive health analysts, and social statistics consultants.

name: Social Work
short_description: Community welfare services, family crisis intervention, correctional casework, and vulnerable populations advocacy.
jamb_subjects: English, and any three Arts or Social Science subjects
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes including English Language, Mathematics and three other subjects
deep_dive: Topics encompass social welfare administration, rehabilitation casework, youth delinquency intervention, medical social work, and social legislation. Students complete mandatory field agency social work placements in orphanages, prisons, and hospitals. Graduates practice as medical social workers, family welfare caseworkers, rehabilitation officers, and NGO project directors.

name: Criminology and Security Studies
short_description: Crime theories, penology, forensic criminal investigation, national intelligence, and policing systems.
jamb_subjects: English, and any three Arts or Social Science subjects
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics and three other subjects
deep_dive: Studies examine criminal profiling, forensic evidence handling, surveillance technologies, corporate security intelligence, and correctional policies. Security agency attachments and criminal investigative workshops prepare students for security architecture. Career opportunities include security intelligence analysts, fraud investigators, law enforcement officers, and corporate loss prevention managers.

name: Tourism and Hospitality Management
short_description: Hotel operations, tourism economics, events coordination, ecotourism planning, and destination marketing.
jamb_subjects: English, Mathematics, Economics, and one other Commercial or Social Science subject
waec_requirements: 5 SSCE credit passes including English Language, Mathematics, Economics and two other subjects
deep_dive: Coursework covers food and beverage management, hotel revenue optimization, convention planning, sustainable tourism, and customer experience. Professional internships in star-rated international hotels and tourism resorts provide direct operational training. Graduates work as hotel general managers, hospitality operations directors, tourism event planners, and travel resort developers.
